title: Surface Parking Lots in Downtown Areas and the Role of Regulatory Delay in Optimal Dynamic Land Use
abstract: In this paper, we explore the implication for urban form, urban structure and optimal land use policy of vacant land used for downtown surface parking lots in urban areas. We develop a dynamic, spatial general equilibrium urban model to show cases where vacant land can be optimal and suboptimal depending upon its temporary use, economic and regulatory conditions as well as externalities. We show in numerical simulations how the structure of the urban economy responds to different policies and consider their implications for different types of cities. These results have important implications for cities concerned about the impacts of vacant land and in particular of surface parking lots in downtown areas.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了城市地区市中心地表停车场所占用的闲置土地对城市形态、城市结构以及最优土地利用政策的影响。我们构建了一个动态的空间一般均衡城市模型，以说明闲置土地在何种情形下可以是最优的、何种情形下是次优的，这取决于其临时用途、经济和监管条件，以及外部性。我们通过数值模拟展示了城市经济结构如何对不同政策作出反应，并探讨了这些结果对不同类型城市的启示。这些结论对于那些关注闲置土地，尤其是市中心地表停车场影响的城市，具有重要意义。

title: How to design better incentives for carbon capture and storage in the United States
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (Opinion)

title: Making Carbon Management Work – navigating technical and policy uncertainty towards a net-zero future
abstract:
Achieving a goal of net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 is expected to require the removal of at least 5–10 Gt of CO
2
per year from the atmosphere, along with reductions in emissions. This will require a focused and sustained effort to overcome challenges in carbon management. We envision a multicomponent carbon management system that will allow optimization of carbon throughput while minimizing financial and social costs and identifying gaps in technological innovation. We convened a Chatham House Rule workshop in Washington, DC in April 2025 with the goal of defining research needs for a systems-level approach to optimizing carbon management. We identified six core research areas for developing an integrated carbon management ecosystem while addressing barriers to adoption: (1) capture and removal technologies, (2) measurement and accounting, (3) sequestration and utilization, (4) technology integration and systems analysis, (5) economic and policy dimensions, and (6) community impacts. The fundamental gaps that need to be bridged include constraining material behavior and process energy intensity; better managing monitoring and reporting data; cost of potential technological pathways; and clarifying the design of legal, regulatory and policy institutions and incentives that encourage socially optimal and equitable development and deployment of optimized carbon management systems. Despite current policy uncertainties surrounding carbon management, a sustained effort in these areas will be required to make carbon management work.
abstract_zh: 要在2050年实现净零碳排放目标，预计需要每年从大气中移除至少5–10 Gt的CO2，同时还需减少排放。这需要持续而集中的努力，以克服碳管理领域的挑战。我们设想建立一个多组分的碳管理系统，以实现碳流量的优化，同时将财务和社会成本降至最低，并识别技术创新中的缺口。2025年4月，我们在华盛顿特区召开了一次“查塔姆研究所规则”（Chatham House Rule）研讨会，旨在界定系统层面优化碳管理的研究需求。我们确定了六个核心研究领域，用于构建综合碳管理生态系统，同时克服采用过程中的障碍：(1) 捕集与移除技术，(2) 测量与核算，(3) 封存与利用，(4) 技术集成与系统分析，(5) 经济与政策维度，以及(6) 社区影响。需要弥合的根本性缺口包括：约束材料行为和过程能源强度；更好地管理监测与报告数据；潜在技术路径的成本；以及明确法律、监管和政策制度与激励机制的设计，以促进社会最优且公平的优化碳管理系统的开发与部署。尽管当前碳管理政策存在诸多不确定性，仍需在上述领域持续努力，才能使碳管理取得成效。

title: Efficiency and Equity Impacts of Urban Transportation Policies with Equilibrium Sorting
abstract: We estimate an equilibrium sorting model of housing location and commuting mode choice with endogenous traffic congestion to evaluate urban transportation policies. Leveraging fine-scale data from travel diaries and housing transactions identifying residents' home and work locations, we recover rich preference heterogeneity over both travel mode and residential location decisions. While different policies produce the same congestion reduction, their impacts on social welfare differ drastically. In addition, sorting undermines the congestion reduction under driving restrictions and subway expansion but strengthens it under congestion pricing. The combination of congestion pricing and subway expansion delivers the greatest congestion relief and efficiency gains. (JEL H76, O18, P25, R23, R31, R41, R48)
abstract_zh: 我们估计了一个包含住房选址与通勤方式选择的均衡分类模型，该模型内生考虑了交通拥堵，以评估城市交通政策。利用旅行日志和住房交易的精细数据（可识别居民的居住地和工作地点），我们揭示了居民在出行方式和居住地选择上丰富的偏好异质性。尽管不同政策带来的拥堵缓解效果相同，但它们对社会福利的影响却大相径庭。此外，居民的分类选择会削弱限行和地铁扩建下的拥堵缓解效果，但会增强拥堵收费下的效果。拥堵收费与地铁扩建相结合，可带来最大的拥堵缓解和效率提升。（JEL H76, O18, P25, R23, R31, R41, R48）

title: State Legislator Views on Funding 21st Century Transportation: Important Problems, Missed Connections
The Value of Urgency: Evidence from Real-Time Congestion Pricing
abstract: In the setting of Los Angeles’s ExpressLanes, we uncover the distribution of individuals’ preferences for time savings in a novel application of a hedonic pricing model. We introduce the concept of the value of urgency, defined by willingness to pay (WTP) a toll to avoid a congested alternative route. The value of urgency does not scale in the amount of time saved, reflecting discrete penalties for late arrival. This value accounts for 87% of total WTP to use the ExpressLanes, while the contributions to WTP from other widely used valuation measures are negligible. We suggest that quality-of-service pricing that varies in real time and removes uncertainty over travel times creates new markets for individuals to reveal their preferences for urgency.
abstract_zh: 以洛杉矶的ExpressLanes为背景，我们通过一种新颖的享乐定价模型应用，揭示了个体对节省时间的偏好分布。我们提出了“紧急价值”（value of urgency）的概念，其定义为为避开拥堵替代路线而愿意支付的通行费（支付意愿，WTP）。紧急价值并不随节省时间的多少而线性增长，这反映了迟到所带来的离散型惩罚。该价值占使用ExpressLanes总支付意愿的87%，而其他常用估值指标的贡献则可以忽略不计。我们认为，实时变化、并消除出行时间不确定性的服务质量定价，将为个体揭示其紧急偏好创造新的市场。

title: Views from the Statehouse: Survey Results from State Legislative Committee Members
What are the likely air pollution impacts of carbon capture and storage?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Because fossil fuels currently account for 60% of U.S. power generation and an even larger share of industrial energy use, a key component of many net-zero carbon plans is the expansion of carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) through tax credits and other incentives. We quantify the potential impacts of CCUS on local air pollution, focusing on the U.S. Gulf region, given a large agglomeration of carbon-intensive industrial facilities and significant CCUS deployment underway. We characterize pre-CCUS local air pollution emissions from fossil-fuel electricity generation and large industrial carbon emitters (e.g., petrochemicals, refining) and compare these with projected post-CCUS local air pollution emissions, leveraging emission factor estimates from the engineering literature. We then analyze net emissions impacts on secondary particulate matter formation and damages via the AP3 integrated air pollution assessment model (Clay, et al. 2019). An important, though under-emphasized aspect of the emissions impact of CCUS is increased ammonia emissions from CCUS technology, which we show can lead to net air pollution damages from CCUS from natural gas power plants and most industrial facilities. These damages partially counterbalance the substantial climate benefits of CCUS adoption. Because facility-level impacts are highly variable, our results highlight potential environmental justice challenges from CCUS deployment. We find that deleterious local air pollution impacts of CCUS are correlated with prior air pollution exposure at both the county and census tract levels, suggesting that CCUS may pose significant tradeoffs between global climate benefits and costs to local communities.
abstract_zh: 由于化石燃料目前占美国发电量的60%，而在工业能源使用中所占份额更大，许多净零碳排放规划的一个关键组成部分，是通过税收抵免和其他激励措施扩大碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）。我们以美国墨西哥湾地区为重点，量化了CCUS对当地空气污染的潜在影响，该地区汇集了大量碳密集型工业设施，且正在大规模部署CCUS。我们刻画了化石燃料发电以及大型工业碳排放源（如石化、炼油）在CCUS实施前的当地空气污染排放情况，并将其与CCUS实施后预计的当地空气污染排放进行比较，所用排放因子估计参考了工程学文献。随后，我们通过AP3综合空气污染评估模型（Clay等，2019）分析了二次颗粒物形成及其损害的净排放影响。CCUS排放影响中一个重要但被低估的方面，是CCUS技术导致的氨排放增加，我们的研究表明，这可能导致天然气发电厂和大多数工业设施的CCUS产生净空气污染损害。这些损害部分抵消了CCUS采用所带来的巨大气候效益。由于设施层面的影响差异很大，我们的结果凸显了CCUS部署可能带来的环境正义挑战。我们发现，CCUS的有害当地空气污染影响与县和普查区层面既有的空气污染暴露程度相关，这表明CCUS可能在全球气候效益与当地社区成本之间带来重大权衡。

title: Leveraging scale economies and policy incentives: Carbon capture, utilization & storage in Gulf clusters
abstract: Carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) represents a set of technologies essential to meeting ambitious mid-to late-century decarbonization goals. Yet deployment of CCUS has been slow, with fewer than 20 large-scale facilities operating worldwide in 2019. We estimate the total and marginal cost of constructing and operating new CCUS facilities and associated infrastructure to reduce carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from current and planned industrial facilities on the Texas and Louisiana Gulf Coast. We compare these cost estimates to scheduled CCUS tax incentives through 2026 under section 45Q of the U.S. Internal Revenue Code to quantify cost-effective emissions abatement. Our analysis measures the cost-reducing potential of economies of scale in regional CO2 pipeline networks. We also compare CCUS costs to one measure of the benefits of carbon capture, the social cost of carbon. Results suggest that U.S. federal tax incentives currently in place through 2026 could justify between 3.3 million and 77.6 million tons of annual CCUS in the Gulf region, depending on the choice of storage technology and the degree of pipeline network coordination. Finally, we highlight several potential policy barriers that may explain low adoption of CCUS in the Gulf Region and elsewhere.
abstract_zh: 碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）是一组对实现雄心勃勃的本世纪中后期脱碳目标至关重要的技术。然而，CCUS的部署进展缓慢，截至2019年，全球运营中的大型设施不足20座。我们估计了在得克萨斯州和路易斯安那州墨西哥湾沿岸，为减少现有及规划中的工业设施二氧化碳（CO2）排放而新建CCUS设施及相关基础设施的总成本与边际成本。我们将这些成本估计与根据美国《国内税收法典》第45Q条规定、计划持续至2026年的CCUS税收激励进行比较，以量化具有成本效益的减排规模。我们的分析衡量了区域CO2管道网络中规模经济的成本降低潜力。我们还将CCUS成本与碳捕集的一种收益衡量指标，即碳的社会成本，进行了比较。结果表明，目前实施至2026年的美国联邦税收激励，可能支持墨西哥湾地区每年340万至7760万吨的CCUS规模，具体取决于封存技术的选择以及管网协调的程度。最后，我们指出了若干可能的政策障碍，这些障碍或许可以解释墨西哥湾地区及其他地区CCUS采用率较低的原因。

title: Emissions in the Stream: Estimating the Greenhouse Gas Impacts of an Oil and Gas Boom
abstract: The Shale Revolution has stimulated a large and rapid buildout of oil and gas infrastructure in the Gulf and Southwest regions of the United States (US), expected to unfold over decades. Therefore, it is critical to develop a clearer understanding of the scale and composition of the likely greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions associated with this activity. We compile a detailed inventory of projected upstream oil and gas production expansions as well as recently and soon-to-be built midstream and downstream facilities within the region. Using data from emissions permits, emissions factors, and facility capacities, we estimate expected GHG emissions at the facility level for facilities that have recently been constructed or are soon to be constructed. Our central estimate suggests that the total annual emissions impact of the regional oil and gas infrastructure buildout may reach 541 million tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e) by 2030, which is more than 8% of total US GHG emissions in 2017 and roughly equivalent to the emissions of 131 coal-fired power plants. A substantial fraction of the projected emissions come from petrochemical facilities (38%) and liquefied natural gas terminals (19%). Researchers have largely focused on upstream emissions such as fugitive methane (CH4) associated with new US production; our findings reveal the potentially greater prominence of midstream and downstream sources in the studied region.
abstract_zh: 页岩革命推动了美国墨西哥湾和西南部地区油气基础设施的大规模快速扩建，预计这一过程将持续数十年。因此，有必要更清楚地认识这一活动可能产生的温室气体（GHG）排放的规模与构成。我们编制了一份详细清单，列出了该地区已规划的上游油气生产扩张项目，以及近期和即将建成的中游与下游设施。利用排放许可数据、排放因子和设施产能数据，我们估计了已建成或即将建成设施的设施层面预期温室气体排放量。我们的中心估计表明，到2030年，该地区油气基础设施扩建带来的年度总排放影响可能达到5.41亿吨二氧化碳当量（CO2e），这超过了美国2017年温室气体排放总量的8%，大致相当于131座燃煤发电厂的排放量。预计排放中有相当大的部分来自石化设施（38%）和液化天然气接收站（19%）。以往研究主要关注与美国新增生产相关的上游排放，例如逸散性甲烷（CH4）；而我们的研究结果揭示，在所研究地区，中游和下游排放源可能更为突出。

title: Tightening Belts to Buy a Home: Consumption Responses to Rising Housing Prices in Urban China
abstract: This paper measures the impact of housing price changes on household consumption at the city level using the universe of credit and debit card transactions in China from 2011 to 2013. In sharp contrast to the literature on the U.S. housing market, our analysis shows a large and negative housing price elasticity of consumption: a 10% increase in housing prices would lead to a 9.1% reduction in non-housing spending. We argue that the negative elasticity is driven by the combination of a strong investment incentive in housing and heavy borrowing constraints faced by households. This is corroborated by the finding that households increase their savings as housing prices increase. title: Can Minimum Wages Close the Gender Wage Gap? Evidence From Indonesia
Do Employers' Responses to Crises Impact Men and Women Differently? Firm-level Evidence from Indonesia
Profit Sharing Between Governments and Multinationals in Natural Resource Extraction: Evidence from a Firm-Level Panel
abstract: The "fairness" of negotiations between countries and resource extracting firms is subject to many accusations and counter-accusations and may be argued, in many instances, to impact the subsequent economic benefit to a host country from extraction. This paper examines the role of host country governance on the share of government take from extraction revenue. We attempt to disentangle a number of competing hypotheses regarding the relationship between governance and government take using panel data for US resource extracting multinational corporations (MNCs) operating abroad from the Bureau of Economic Analysis of the US Department of Commerce over 1982-1999.Using fixed effects regression, we find a statistically significant positive impact of institutional quality on government take. The nature of this relationship --whether this represents the result of a "corruption premium" paid by US MNCs or the exploitation of poor governance in negotiating government take --is not completely clear. The evidence presented does, however, indicate that potential forms of bargaining power other than institutional quality (e.g., outside options to the deal) do increase government take, indicating that bargaining power may nonetheless be an important factor.
abstract_zh: 各国与资源开采企业之间谈判的“公平性”，常常受到诸多指控与反指控，并且在许多情况下，可能被认为会影响东道国从开采中获得的后续经济收益。本文考察了东道国治理状况对政府在开采收入中所占份额的影响。我们利用美国商务部经济分析局1982至1999年间，美国资源开采跨国公司（MNC）在海外运营的面板数据，试图厘清关于治理与政府所得份额之间关系的若干相互竞争的假说。采用固定效应回归，我们发现制度质量对政府所得份额具有统计上显著的正向影响。这种关系的性质——究竟是美国跨国公司支付的“腐败溢价”的结果，还是对薄弱治理在谈判中被利用的结果——尚不完全清楚。然而，所提供的证据确实表明，除制度质量以外的其他形式的谈判能力（例如交易的外部选择）会提高政府所得份额，这表明谈判能力可能仍然是一个重要因素。

title: Maintaining Vehicle Emission Reduction Rates Requires Policies to Remove Cars from the Road
abstract: This paper seeks to understand the localized effect of automobile congestion on air pollution. We leverage air pollution sensors on Google Street View cars combined with fine grain speed and vehicle density observations on Los Angeles Highways, to understand this effect at level of granularity never previously considered using causally identified methods. We show that higher pollution occurs at very low and very high speeds due to lowered engine efficiency. Given the success to date of reducing pollution via tailpipe emission standards, we show that the magnitude of our effects points to the need to focus more attention by policymakers on vehicle speeds for further mitigation of health impacts from vehicle emissions. Our results have important implications for understanding human health effects of anti-congestion policies, speed limits and point to a need to better regulate sources of fine particulate matter pollution from tires and brakes.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在理解汽车拥堵对空气污染的局部效应。我们利用安装在谷歌街景车上的空气污染传感器，结合洛杉矶高速公路上精细粒度的车速和车辆密度观测数据，采用因果识别方法，在前所未有的细致程度上考察了这一效应。我们发现，由于发动机效率降低，在极低和极高车速下污染会更加严重。鉴于迄今通过尾气排放标准减少污染已取得成效，我们的研究表明，其效应的大小意味着政策制定者需要更多关注车速问题，以进一步减轻机动车排放对健康的影响。我们的研究结果对于理解反拥堵政策、限速措施对人体健康的影响具有重要意义，并指出有必要更好地监管轮胎和刹车产生的细颗粒物污染源。

title: Pain at the Pump & the Ballot Box: Gas Taxes & Electoral Penalties
abstract: Perhaps the greatest challenge to addressing climate change comprehensively through government policy in the US has been limited political feasibility. We investigate whether politicians are punished by voters for increasing motor fuel taxes by compiling a comprehensive dataset on state legislative election outcomes and gasoline taxes. Leveraging a difference-in-discontinuities research design, we estimate the effect of legislated gasoline tax changes on incumbent state legislators’ subsequent electoral outcomes. For very close elections, we show how the incumbency advantage attenuates when gasoline tax increases have been legislated in the intervening legislative session. Specifically, we find a small, but economically and statistically meaningful decrease in the incumbency advantage of 1.3 to 1.9 percentage points for Republican and Democratic incumbents, respectively. This penalty represents 14-21% of the overall electoral advantage of incumbents in our sample, which highlights the relative importance of environmental and energy taxes in voter priorities.
abstract_zh: 在美国，通过政府政策全面应对气候变化所面临的最大挑战，或许是政治上的可行性有限。我们通过汇编一份关于州立法机构选举结果与汽油税的综合数据集，考察选民是否会因政治家提高机动车燃油税而施以惩罚。我们采用双重不连续设计（difference-in-discontinuities），估计了立法规定的汽油税变动对现任州议员随后选举结果的影响。在非常接近的选举中，我们表明，若在其间的立法会期中通过了汽油税提高的立法，现任者的在职优势会被削弱。具体而言，我们发现，对于共和党和民主党现任者，在职优势分别下降了1.3和1.9个百分点，尽管幅度较小，但在经济上和统计上均具有意义。这一惩罚相当于我们样本中现任者整体选举优势的14%–21%，这凸显了环境与能源税在选民优先事项中的相对重要性。

title: The Long Road to Work: Divergent Effects of Transportation Policies by Worker Skill in a Locational Sorting Model
abstract: This paper examines the e ect of transportation policies directed at reducing travel times for commuting on inequality in urban labor markets. I consider the choice of city of residence by workers with and without a college degree to model the e ect of changes in commuting patterns on economic inequality. Behavioral and supply parameters are estimated in a sorting model that controls for the e ect on location decisions vis-a-vis wages, rents and amenities. Compelling ndings emerging from these estimates include the fact that while cities with the most productive skilled workers tend to have shorter commutes, the opposite relationship holds for unskilled workers commuting from suburbs, yet these workers seem to bene t from living in cities that have more e cient transportation systems. This would suggest that availability of better transportation infrastructure may not be the constraining factor for productive low skilled workers. I also nd that these relationships seem to hold for public transit usage, where more productive cities tend to have higher rates of commuting via public transit by skilled workers, and less productive workers higher rates of usage by unskilled workers. Based on these estimates, policy simulations consider the e ect of public transit expansion to lower travel times to work nanced by a head tax, congestion pricing or fare increase. Overall the paper documents limited bene ts to workers without a college education from the set of proposed policies relative to those with a degree. These results have important distributional consequences for national and state-level policies intended to mitigate congestion externalities and spatial mismatch of workers in urban labor markets, suggesting that alternative policies that reallocate workers in space might better serve equity concerns. ∗I am very grateful for the generous support of my adviser, Antonio Bento, as well as help from committee members Shanjun Li, Nick Kumino and Ricardo Daziano. I also thank Jonathan Hall, Joseph Shapiro, Matthew Kahn, Richard Klotz, Kevin Roth, and participants at the 3rd Northeast Workshop on Energy Policy and Environmental Economics and 2015 NBER EEE Summer Institute for their feedback. Alberto Saiz kindly provided his land availability dataset for use in this paper. I acknowledge support from the Cornell Graduate Fellowship, and the Arizona State University Center for Environmental Economics and Sustainability Policy Pre-Doctoral Fellowship.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了旨在缩短通勤时间的交通政策，对城市劳动力市场中不平等的影响，并按劳动者技能区分。我们考虑了具有和不具有大学学位的劳动者对居住城市的选择，以模拟通勤模式变化对经济不平等的影响。行为参数与供给参数是在一个分类模型中估计的，该模型控制了工资、租金和舒适度对居住地决策的影响。这些估计得出了若干有意义的发现：尽管拥有最具生产力的技术型劳动者的城市往往通勤时间较短，但对于从郊区通勤的非技术型劳动者，情况恰恰相反；然而，这些劳动者似乎能从拥有更高效交通系统的城市中获益。这表明，更好的交通基础设施的可得性，可能并非制约高生产力低技能劳动者的主要因素。我还发现，这些关系对公共交通的使用同样成立：生产率较高的城市中，技术型劳动者的公共交通通勤比例往往更高，而生产率较低的城市中，非技术型劳动者的公共交通使用比例更高。基于这些估计，政策模拟考虑了以人头税、拥堵收费或票价上调为资金来源，扩大公共交通以缩短通勤时间的效果。总体而言，本文表明，与拥有学位的劳动者相比，在所提出的这些政策中，未受过大学教育的劳动者所获益处有限。这些结果对于旨在缓解拥堵外部性以及城市劳动力市场中劳动者空间错配的国家和州一级政策，具有重要的分配性后果，并表明，通过在空间上重新配置劳动者的替代政策，可能更能服务于公平关切。我非常感谢我的导师Antonio Bento的慷慨支持，也感谢委员会成员Shanjun Li、Nick Kumino和Ricardo Daziano的帮助。我还感谢Jonathan Hall、Joseph Shapiro、Matthew Kahn、Richard Klotz、Kevin Roth，以及第三届东北能源政策与环境经济学研讨会和2015年NBER EEE暑期学院的与会者提出的反馈意见。Alberto Saiz慷慨地为本文提供了他的土地可用性数据集。我感谢康奈尔大学研究生奖学金以及亚利桑那州立大学环境经济与可持续政策中心的博士前研究奖学金的支持。
